S0737.L3t: The earliest evidence of wild grain harvesting and consumption in Israel is associated with the Epipaleolithic period, specifically the Kebaran culture, which dates to around 20,000 years before present.
S0737.L3f: Wild grain harvesting and consumption in Israel began during the Pre-Pottery Neolithic B period, around 8,000 years before present, when early farming communities were established.
